spots.name: Heidelberg Castle

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Heidelberg Castle is a ruin in Germany and landmark of Heidelberg. The castle ruins are among the most important Renaissance structures north of the Alps.

spots.name: Heidelberg University
spots.summary: Heidelberg University, officially the Ruprecht Karl University of Heidelberg, is a public research university in Heidelberg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany.

names.ja: ルプレヒト・カール大学ハイデルベルク

spots.name: Old Bridge
spots.summary: The Karl Theodor Bridge, commonly known as the Old Bridge, is an arch bridge in Heidelberg that crosses the Neckar river. It connects the Old City with the eastern part of the Neuenheim district of the city on the opposite bank.

spots.name: Church of the Holy Spirit, Heidelberg

hours.note: Closed Sun

spots.summary: The Church of the Holy Spirit is the largest church in Heidelberg, Germany. The church, located in the marketplace in the old town center, was constructed between 1398 and 1515 in the Romanesque and Gothic styles. It receives 1–3 million guests annually, making it among the most visited churches in Germany.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Church of the Holy Spirit, Heidelberg

names.ja: 聖霊教会 (ハイデルベルク)

spots.name: Königstuhl
spots.summary: The Königstuhl, is a 567.8 metres (1,863 ft) high hill in the Odenwald Mountains and in the city of Heidelberg, in the German state of Baden-Württemberg. The Königstuhl summit allows visitors views of the city of Heidelberg and the Neckar river.

names.ja: ケーニッヒシュトゥール

spots.name: Heidelberg Bridge Monkey
spots.summary: The Heidelberg Bridge Monkey dates back to the 15th century. It was a stone statue sitting in the tower of the Old Bridge, which was located opposite Heidelberg's Old Town. The purpose of the tower was to instill fear and respect in anyone arriving in the town, while the monkey represented mockery.

spots.name: Philosophenweg
spots.summary: Street on the northern side of the city. It provides a wonderful view across the oldest part of the city. Here you can find the site of the famous Merian Stich, an engraving that is a popular illustration of Heidelberg.

spots.name: Jesuitenkirche (Heidelberg)
spots.summary: It has 1712 Baroque construction with modern touches inside.

spots.name: Heidelberg old town
spots.summary: Hauptstraße is the main street, which leads from Bismarckplatz across the old town. Approximately 1.6 km in length, it is reputedly the longest pedestrian shopping street in Germany.

names.ja: ハイデルベルク旧市街

spots.name: Hauptstraße
spots.summary: The Hauptstrasse is the central street of Heidelberg's old town, the Altstadt, running the full length of the quarter. Today, it is a pedestrianised zone and popular shopping street. Numerous landmarks are located along its course, including the Town Hall, the Church of the Holy Spirit, and the Church of Providence.

spots.name: Heidelberg Hauptbahnhof
spots.summary: Heidelberg Hauptbahnhof is the main railway station for the city of Heidelberg. In 2005 it was used by around 42,000 passengers per day and is one of the largest passenger stations in the German state of Baden-Württemberg. The station is classified by Deutsche Bahn as a category 2 station.

names.ja: ハイデルベルク中央駅

spots.name: Marktplatz
spots.summary: The Marktplatz is a central square in Heidelberg's old town, the Altstadt. It has served as a marketplace since the establishment of the city in medieval times. The Hauptstrasse runs along one side and the Church of the Holy Spirit and the Town Hall are located on the square.

spots.name: Kurpfälzisches Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Kurpfälzisches Museum is a museum of art and archaeology in Heidelberg, Germany. It is located in the Palais Morass. It was founded in the late 1870s, when the city of Heidelberg purchased the private collection of the artist and art historian Charles de Graimberg.

names.fr: Musée du Palatinat de la ville de Heidelberg

spots.name: Max Planck Institute for Astronomy
spots.summary: The Max-Planck-Institut für Astronomie is a research institute of the Max Planck Society (MPG). It is located in Heidelberg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany near the top of the Königstuhl, adjacent to the historic Landessternwarte Heidelberg-Königstuhl astronomical observatory.

names.ja: マックス・プランク天文学研究所
names.zh: 马克斯·普朗克天文研究所

spots.name: Heiligenberg
spots.summary: The Heiligenberg is a large wooded hill overlooking the town of Heidelberg in Baden-Württemberg, Germany. It rises to around 440 metres NHN.

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Heidelberg Zoo
spots.summary: Heidelberg Zoo is a zoo in Germany which was founded in 1933 and opened for the public on 20 November 1934. Since 1998, the zoo director has been Klaus Wünnemann.

spots.name: Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities
spots.summary: The Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities, established in 1909 in Heidelberg, Germany, is an assembly of scholars and scientists in the German state of Baden-Wuerttemberg.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities

names.nl: Heidelberg Academie voor Wetenschappen en Geesteswetenschappen
names.es: Academia de Ciencias y Humanidades de Heidelberg
names.ja: ハイデルブルク学術協会
names.zh: 海德堡科學與人文學院

spots.name: Kornmarkt
spots.summary: The Kornmarkt is a square in the Altstadt of Heidelberg, near the Marktplatz. The north edge of the Kornmarkt is marked by the Hauptstrasse, the south by Ingrimstrasse and Karlstrasse. The Burgweg, which leads up to Heidelberg Castle, begins to the south of the Kornmarkt.

spots.name: Heidelberg University Library
spots.summary: The Heidelberg University Library is the central library of the Heidelberg University. Together with the 83 decentralized libraries of the faculties and institutes, it forms the University Library System, which is headed by the director of the University Library.

names.es: Biblioteca de la Universidad de Heidelberg
names.ja: ハイデルベルク大学図書館

photo.author: Stateofthings. Original uploader was Stateofthings at de.wikipedia

spots.name: Heidelberg Thingstätte
spots.summary: The Heidelberg Thingstätte is an open-air theatre on the Heiligenberg in Heidelberg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. It was built during the Third Reich for performances and events as part of the Thingspiel movement. Until 2018, it was primarily used for unofficial Walpurgis Night celebrations.

spots.name: Hortus Palatinus
spots.summary: The Hortus Palatinus, or Garden of the Palatinate, was a Baroque garden attached to Heidelberg Castle, Germany.

spots.name: President Friedrich Ebert Memorial
spots.summary: The President Friedrich Ebert Foundation Memorial in Heidelberg is a non-partisan foundation financed by the German Federal Government. It commemorates the life and work of Friedrich Ebert, who was born in the house on 4 February 1871.

names.ja: フリードリヒ・エーベルト大統領記念館
names.zh: 弗里德里希·艾伯特总统纪念馆

spots.name: Fernsehturm Heidelberg

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Fernsehturm Heidelberg is a transmission tower for FM and DVB-T on the Königstuhl hill of Heidelberg at. It was the property of the City of Heidelberg and sold to the SWR. Because of its exposed location on the crest of the hill the tower itself is only 82 meters high.

spots.name: Prinzhorn Collection

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Prinzhorn Collection is a German collection of art made by mental health patients, housed at the Heidelberg University Hospital. The collection comprises over 20,000 works, including works by Emma Hauck, Agnes Richter and August Natterer.

spots.name: Heidelberger Bergbahn
spots.summary: The Heidelberg Mountain Railway is a two-section funicular railway in the city of Heidelberg, Germany. The first section runs from a lower station at Kornmarkt in Heidelberg's Altstadt, via an intermediate station at Heidelberg Castle, to an upper station at Molkenkur.

names.ja: Sプリンティングホース

spots.name: Neuburg Abbey
spots.summary: Neuburg Abbey near Heidelberg in Baden-Württemberg is a Benedictine monastery dedicated to Saint Bartholomew, and part of the Beuronese Congregation.

spots.name: University Square
spots.summary: The Universitätsplatz, previously known as Paradeplatz, Ludwigsplatz, and Langemarckplatz (1937-1945) is an open square in Heidelberg's old town, the Altstadt. The Hauptstrasse runs along the north side, the west side is marked by Grabengasse, which follows the line of the original city walls.

spots.name: Providence Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of Providence is a Protestant church on the Hauptstrasse of the old town of Heidelberg. Until the union of the Protestant Church in Baden in 1821, this was the Lutheran church of central Heidelberg, while the Church of the Holy Spirit was the meeting place of the Calvinist church.

spots.name: Kornmarkt-Madonna
spots.summary: The Kornmarkt-Madonna is a fountain sculpture in the Kornmarkt in the Altstadt of Heidelberg. It is also known as the Mariensäule and Muttergottesbrunnen.

spots.name: Bismarckplatz
spots.summary: The Bismarckplatz in Heidelberg is a square named for Otto von Bismarck, located at the western end of the Hauptstrasse, which forms the boundary between the old city and the suburb of Bergheim.

spots.name: Ethnographic Museum Heidelberg

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue

spots.summary: The Ethnographic Museum of the J. and E. von Portheim Foundation is a cultural history museum located in the old town of Heidelberg, Germany. Situated in the Palais Weimar, it maintains extensive collections on daily life, art, and religion from various regions of the world.

hours.note: Closed Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat

spots.name: Monastery of St. Michael

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Monastery of St. Michael German: Michaelskloster, on the Heiligenberg in Heidelberg, was a branch of the nearby Lorsch Abbey. The ruined complex that can be seen today was built beginning in 1023. The monastery was occupied successively by several religious orders before it was abandoned in the 16th century.

spots.name: Documentation and Cultural Centre of German Sinti and Roma

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Documentation and Cultural Centre of German Sinti and Roma was established in Heidelberg, Germany, in the early 1990s, as a memorial to Sinti and Roma people who were killed by the National Socialists Party.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St. Peter's Church is the oldest church in the old town (Altstadt) of Heidelberg, Germany. It has generally served as the university church of the University of Heidelberg since the late Middle Ages.

spots.name: Weißer Stein
spots.summary: Weißer Stein is the name of a 548-metre (1,798 ft) high hill in Germany, located in the Odenwald, north of Heidelberg and east of Dossenheim.

spots.name: Theater & Orchester Heidelberg
spots.summary: Theater & Orchester Heidelberg is a theatre in Heidelberg, Baden-Württemberg. The Heidelberger Stückemarkt, an annual theatre festival and competition for emerging playwrights, is held at the theatre.

names.ja: ハイデルベルク市立劇場

spots.summary: The old armoury is now a student cafeteria (open to the public and offering good food and drinks at reasonable prices).

spots.name: Botanical Garden of the University of Heidelberg

hours.note: Closed Sat

spots.summary: The Botanischer Garten der Universität Heidelberg, also known as the Botanischer Garten Heidelberg, is a botanical garden maintained by the University of Heidelberg.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Botanical Garden of the University of Heidelberg

hours.note: Closed Mon, Sun

spots.name: Haus zum Riesen
spots.summary: The Haus zum Riesen is a baroque palace on the Hauptstrasse in Heidelberg, built in 1707/8. The building is named for a statue with decorates the façade. Since the middle of the nineteenth century, it has been used by Heidelberg University and several prominent academics have worked in it.

spots.summary: Maybe the most beautiful university canteen in Germany, offering food and beer at low prices in a historic building and a beer garden! Everybody is welcome, 'outsiders' need to pay cash. Open till 21:00, closed on Sunday.
